description.en:
The switch status. Valid values:

- **on**: Enable
- **off**: Disable

description.zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
description.en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English

description.zh:
设置是否需要配置资产。默认**false**。取值：
- **true**：需要
- **false**：不需要
> 该值仅对**config**为**on**时有效
description.en:
Specifies whether asset configuration is required. Default value: **false**. Valid values:
- **true**: Required
- **false**: Not required
> This value takes effect only when **config** is set to **on**.
The IP address of the access source.

description.zh:
开关类型。取值：

- **auto_breaking**：防病毒
- **ransomware_breaking**：防勒索（诱饵捕获）
- **webshell\_cloud_breaking**：网站后门连接防御
- **alinet**：恶意网络行为防御
- **k8s\_log_analysis**：容器K8s威胁检测
- **alisecguard**：客户端自保护防御模式
description.en:
The switch type. Valid values:

- **auto_breaking**: Anti-virus
- **ransomware_breaking**: Anti-ransomware (bait capture)
- **webshell\_cloud_breaking**: Website backdoor connection defense
- **alinet**: Malicious network behavior defense
- **k8s\_log_analysis**: Container K8s threat detection
- **alisecguard**: Client self-protection defense mode

title.zh: 设置异常事件全局配置
title.en: Set the global configuration for abnormal events

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas operate-suspicious-overall-config --source-ip 222.178.XX.XX --lang zh --type k8s_log_analysis --config off --no-target-as-on true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas OperateSuspiciousOverallConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Type k8s_log_analysis --SourceIp '222.178.XX.XX' --Config off --NoTargetAsOn true --Lang zh
